age.Description: Not given per participant; cohort mean age 30.5 +- 4.4 years (article)

sex.Description: Not given per participant; cohort 15 female, 13 male (article)

handedness.Description: All participants right-handed (Edinburgh Handedness Inventory; article)

n_seeg_channels.Description: Channels typed SEEG in this participant's files

diagnosis.Description: Paper Methods: SEEG evaluation 'for refractory partial epilepsy'. Applies to every participant.

implant_type.Description: Stereotactic depth electrodes (SEEG): 0.8 mm diameter, 8-15 contacts of 2 mm length, 3.5 mm centre-to-centre (paper Methods).

n_channels_in_source_file.Description: Number of channels in header.chanlocs of the participant's .lw5 files (identical for both conditions). Includes scalp EEG (s-prefixed 10-20 labels), physiological/marker channels (ECG, PULS+, BEAT+, SpO2+, MKR) and unused/placeholder channels; it is NOT the number of intracerebral contacts. Source: header.chanlocs of the .lw5 files (read 2026-10-08).
